name: Punctuation Pattern
description: Analyzes punctuation usage patterns for AI detection.
useCase: Identifying AI text through predictable punctuation
mechanism: Detects sharp intensity transitions as proxy for punctuation marks and analyzes their spacing regularity. AI text shows more predictable punctuation patterns.
source: Fagni et al. (2021) - TweepFake, PLOS ONE
parameters: Window size: adaptive, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropy, CV, correlation
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated text
- Language-agnostic statistical approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger false positives
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies across writing styles

references.title: Fagni et al. (2021) - TweepFake, PLOS ONE
Uchendu, A. et al. (2020). Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation. EMNLP.
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. arXiv.
